report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, and INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR trace shows a 1947ms inventory call, which is insufficient to establish a bounded root cause. No service-level evidence for downstream components exists, so the alert cannot be attributed. Handing off for targeted downstream telemetry.
missing_evidence: Traces for order, inventory, payment, and redis spans during the alert window to localize the failing hop
Per-service error-rate and p95 latency metrics for order, inventory, payment, and redis
Logs from order/inventory/payment showing error details and timeout messages
Confirmation of whether the single ERROR trace is representative or an isolated outlier
